title: Cheaper to the customer and higher margin at the same time
subtitle: Per million output tokens. Illustrative. Prices and the NVIDIA cost are assumptions; only the 62.5% cost ratio comes from Wafer's own self-reported benchmark.
caption: The shorter bar is the cheaper price; the larger top segment is the better margin. A 20% discount with a higher gross margin is the entire investment case in one picture, and every input except the cost ratio is assumed. Fireworks AI's gross margin was about 50% as of July 2025.
source: Memo's illustrative model. Cost ratio from Wafer's July 2026 GLM-5.2 benchmark: about 80% of B200 throughput at under half the cost.
